newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet, late trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet, late trade.

text.p: Spot U.S. liquefied petroleum gas prices were stable in quiet late trade on Friday amid weaker NYMEX futures, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane was pegged between 34.00 cents and 34.50 cents a gallon, about a quarter cent weaker than Thursday.
Conway, Kansas, spot material was on par with Belvieu in very quiet activity.
The butane markets were also steady and sinking. Belvieu normal butane was 37.50/38.00 cents and isobutane was about 43.75 cents. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
